RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Arrival of M.O.Koteneff.
------------------------

On 2/5/35 information was received by the undersigned
that Mr. Osvald Koteneff, a Soviet Agent formerly connect-
ed with U.S.S.R., had arrived at Shanghai on 24/4/35. He
is at present staying in Room No.247, Astor House Hotel
and is frequently visited by Mr. Borisoff. The latter
is also believed to be a Soviet Agent as he often uses
m/cars of the Soviet Consulate.

Mr. O.Koteneff is maintaining telegraphic communica-
tion with Moscow addressing his telegrams as follows:
'Rudy, Moskow, Soljank Odin Kvart.151".

Majority of telegrams have been sent in code. A copy
of a telegram sent on 2/5/35 was obtained by the under-
signed and is attached hereto.

M.O. Koteneff 抵达。
---

1935年5月2日，签署人收到情报称，前与苏联有关联的苏联特工 Osvald Koteneff 先生已于1935年4月24日抵达上海。他目前住在礼查饭店（Astor House Hotel）247号房间，Borisoff 先生经常拜访他。后者也被认为是苏联特工，因为他经常使用苏联领事馆的机动车。

O. Koteneff 先生正与莫斯科保持电报通信，其电报地址如下：
“Rudy, Moskow, Soljank Odin Kvart.151”。

大多数电报均以密码发送。签署人获取了一份1935年5月2日发出的电报副本，并附于此。
